head: War
Years
Point
rows: **Treaty of Madras (1769)**: restitution + defensive alliance; Nizam + Marathas + British vs **Hyder**
**Porto Novo (1781)**: **Eyre Coote**; **Mangalore (1784)**: status quo; GG ==Warren Hastings== (APPSC-GS 2025)
Tipu attacked ==**Travancore** (1789)==; **Seringapatam (1792)**: half territory, **Rs 3 crore**, **two sons** hostage
Fear of Tipu-**Napoleon** link; **Wellesley** defeated Tipu (APPSC-G1 2004); Mysore partitioned

boxes.title: Mysore rulers & causes
items: Causes: **Malabar pepper**, cardamom; threat to **Madras**; **French** alliances
Capital **Srirangapatnam**; **Haidar Ali**: arsenal at ==**Dindigul (1755)**== with French help
**Tipu**: envoys to **France**; ==built a navy== (APPSC-G1 2018); **Jacobin Club**; **Tree of Liberty**
Nizam Ali regained **Bellary, Gurramkonda, Gandikota, Kambham, Kadapa** (1792)
**1795 Kharda**: Nizam blamed **Shore**; French under **Raymond**; Resident **Kirkpatrick** → alliance **1798**

boxes.title: Paramountcy & AP angle
items: Lord Hastings: subsidiary alliance → ==**paramountcy**==; Nepal war ended non-intervention
**Rajputana (1818)**: **Udaipur, Jaipur, Jodhpur** subordinate alliances; states had "no international life"
Yandabo: **Assam, Manipur, Arakan, Tenasserim**; Sikkim: **two British doctors** detained
Awadh: **cotton market**, agrarian wealth; British India **Hindukush** to **Burma** by **1856**
Nellore, Chittoor annexed **1801**: collusion with Tipu; Wellesley merged Andhra into **Madras Presidency**
BPSC 2025 order: **Wandiwash (1760)**, **Nand Kumar** hanged (1775), Salbai, Tipu's death
